description.en: Skill, robot and workflow plugins for DeepSeek Harness: Skills package capability and knowledge, Robots turn that into individuals with a defined role, and Workflows drive several robots through a pre-defined flow with explicit human-intervention checkpoints. Installable from Plugins → Discover.
description.zh-cn: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的能力 · 机器人 · 工作流三层插件：Skills 把能力与知识打包成技能，Robots 把技能装进有明确职责的个体，Workflows 用事先定好、运行中不临时改动的流程驱动多个机器人完成复杂工程，并在关键节点停下来等你介入。可在 Plugins 的 Discover 页安装。
